mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances with 3-month FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 3.0% for two consecutive months signals tight labor market conditions that boost corporate margins and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns negative in >55% of UNRATE < 3.0% instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction permits (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate robust economic activity that signals strong earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns negative in >55% of HOUST and INDPRO simultaneous increases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, declining unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) combined with rising consumer spending (RSAFS) signals overheating and impending policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive in >55% of late-cycle instances with UNRATE < 3.5% and rising RSAFS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns positive in >55% of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over 6 months indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns negative in >55% of 6-month PAYEMS growth instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates tightening labor market coupled with monetary policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive in >55% of UNRATE decline and FEDFUNDS rise instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansions, industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 100 (index) signals weak manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as the economy recovers.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns positive in >55% of early-cycle INDPRO < 100 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.
